Definition: a Jakinite (collectively) or descendants of Jakin
BiblicalUsage: The Jachinites were the family of Jachin, counted among the sons of Simeon in the wilderness census. The name marks a whole household by one ancestor, the way Israel kept its families.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts families, not just crowds, and every household has its place in His book.
